thread:
Maria (sales): Hypernova RFI landed — they sent a 40‑page questionnaire and want a capability matrix + POC cost tiers + security answers. Link: https://files.redwood/hypernova/rfi-2026.pdf
Ravi (eng): Uploaded a starter capability CSV: https://s3.redwood/hypernova/capability-matrix.csv — it's a rough mapping of our features to their checklist. I'll flag where we need feature clarifications.
Ana (solutions): Thanks. Can we split tasks? I'll take POC scope & runbook, Ravi you handle throughput/latency guarantees and quantization guidance, Jamie you take HSM/KMS + audit logs answers.
Jamie (security): Noted. Two quick asks: 1) do they require FedRAMP or SOC2 attestation in the RFI? 2) Any encryption-in-use specifics (bring-your-own-key vs. managed KMS)?
Maria (sales): They marked 'high' for regulatory and listed 'HSM or customer-managed KMS' as preferred. No FedRAMP checkbox, but they asked about on‑prem/air‑gapped options.
Ravi (eng): For the capability matrix I've marked three blockers: a) model quantization to int8 on some architectures (we support but need curated ops), b) cross‑region latency SLOs for private deployments, c) per-request KV cache visibility for tracing — TBD.
Ana (solutions): POC timeline proposed: 2 week bench + 1 week integration + 1 week acceptance = 4 weeks. Pricing: list price for hosted dev (per‑token), reserved Dedicated commit options, and an optional Private deployment uplift. I'll draft a price table and attach.
ops-bot: Reminder — attach runbook and security checklist to the CRM entry: https://crm.redwood/deals/HRP-0042
Jamie (security): I'll paste short answers into the questionnaire doc and add an appendix for KMS/HSM diagrams. For network isolation: recommend peered VPC plus egress rules, we support customer VPC peering and private control plane.
Ravi (eng): Quick config snippet for benchmark VMs to include in the runbook:
```
# sample workload config
model: redwood/llama-70b-quantized
batch_size: 16
max_tokens: 512
gpu_type: A100-80GB
kv_cache: enabled
```
Ravi (eng): Also adding recommended quantization profile and expected throughput numbers to the CSV.
Maria (sales): Can we aim to deliver the first draft of RFI answers + matrix by EOD Thursday? Hypernova wants the POC pricing range by Friday AM.
Ana (solutions): I'll own the runbook doc and price table. Tagging acceptance criteria: token latency < 250ms p50, throughput >= 1.2k tokens/s for their baseline.
Jamie (security): I'll provide the KMS/HSM SLA language and the audit log retention options (30/90/365 days). Any legalese to run by legal?
Maria (sales): Yes — legal will want final wording for SLA and data residency clauses. I'll loop in legal after we have security/lifecycle answers.
Ravi (eng): One blocker note for the matrix row 'model-level custom kernels' — engineering needs to confirm kernel support for their proprietary ops. I can confirm by Wednesday.
Ana (solutions): Adding checklist item: customer will require connectivity test (ip ranges + test plan). I'll add the IP ranges and steps in the runbook.
Maria (sales): Perfect. Please react with :thumbsup: when you add your sections. I'll compile and send to the buyer once we have all pieces.
Ravi (eng): :thumbsup:
Ana (solutions): :thumbsup:
Jamie (security): :thumbsup:
ops-bot: File attachments uploaded to deal folder: rfi-answers-draft.docx, capability-matrix.csv, poc-runbook.md
